title: StockSmart Storeroom Desk Guidance — Bin Changes, Special Stock, Par Reviews and Critical Flags
content:
The StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program lets the customer reshape its bins, and lets Corbett clear bins that no longer move. The desk applies the following rules.

**Bin changes on request.** The customer may ask to add bins, change par levels or remove bins at any time on an active program. The words "changes take effect from the next visit or scan" that close this rule are **no longer in force**; they are superseded by the current basis for when a bin change takes effect.

**Special stock.** A bin holds special (non-catalog) stock only while the program's special stock items stay within the tier's special stock item limit; special stock is subject to buyback when the program ends.

**Par reviews.** At each par review, every par level review interval of the tier in months, Corbett removes bins with no replenishment or consumption for the tier's non-moving removal period in months, with the removal reason non-moving.

**Critical flags.** A bin is flagged critical only at the customer's written request; critical flags matter only under a credit hold.

### How the rules sort requests

| Request or event | Who acts | Condition in this guidance |
|---|---|---|
| Add a bin, change a par level, remove a bin | the customer asks | the program is active |
| Hold special stock in a bin | the program | special stock items stay within the tier's limit |
| Remove a non-moving bin | Corbett, at the par review | no replenishment or consumption for the tier's non-moving period |
| Flag a bin critical | the customer, in writing | written request |

### Basis questions

**May a customer ask for a new bin while its program is paused?** This guidance grants the customer's right to ask for bin changes on an active program; it states that right for no other status.

**Does a critical flag change anything while the customer's credit account is active?** No. Critical flags matter only under a credit hold.

superseded_clauses: changes take effect from the next visit or scan.
